DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、ごめん……今ちょっと時間大丈夫？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その……あたしのこと、迎えに来てくれない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 身元保証人が必要みたいなんだけど、生徒会には連絡しづらくって……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 場所はその、えっと……交番

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 交番！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は来てくれてありがと、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 生徒会に連絡してたら、危うく二重で小言の嵐になるところだったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: これからは気を付けてね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん。公共の場では、グラフィティはやらないようにする……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日約束した通り、今度は大きなキャンバスで一緒に絵を描こうね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 約束だよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、約束

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日もお疲れ様、先生。気を付けて帰ってね～！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: マキもお疲れ様

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は今日の放課後、何か用事とかある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あたしはブラックマー

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: や、南区の方に用事があるから、先に帰るね～

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……ブラックマーケット？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もったいない……大勢の人にBOOMの魅力を伝えるチャンスだったのに

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 人に迷惑がかかるやり方はダメだって……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うぅ、先生がダメって言うなら仕方ない……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういえば先生って、BOOMやったことある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ううん、ないよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今度ダウンロードしてあげるから、一緒に「スピードラン」やろう！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 3分以内にクリアできるようになるまで、私が横で手伝ってあげるから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: その言い方、もしかして3分の壁を切るの相当難しいのでは……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は今回の小テストの話、他の誰かから聞いた？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 信じられないぐらい難しかったんだけど！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 普段からちゃんと予習・復習をしないとダメだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もしかしてテスト範囲外の問題が出たとか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うっ、正論……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ううん、そういうわけじゃないんだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とにかく！このままだと補習授業を受けることになっちゃうよ～！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、助けて～！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 勉強教えてくれてありがと、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生の期待に応えられるように、次のテストでは満点取ってくるね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、楽しみにしてる

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、もう一つ質問なんだけど、

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ノートの最後にあるクーリングオフの説明って、全科目のテストに出るの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: マキちゃん、ちょっと落ち着こうか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！この前のテスト、満点だったよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、先生がこの前勉強見てくれたおかげ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: おめでとう、マキも勉強頑張ったね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 偉いでしょ？もっと褒めて～！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ頑張ったマキのために、市内でアイスクリームを買ってあげようかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本当！？約束だよ、先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もうスクショ撮ったから、後で知らんぷりとかダメだからね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ゴミの片づけ手伝ってくれてありがと、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それから、見逃してくれたのも。ありがとね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今回のことは、善意だったんでしょ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん！あっ……でも、お巡りさんに見つかって怒られたらどうしよう……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その時は先生が「違うんです」って言ってね！絶対だよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、グッドニュース！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: このメッセージを見たら、この前グラフィティを描いた壁まで来てくれる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 来れば分かるから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、ちゃんと汚れてもいい服でね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、先生と一緒にグラフィティができて楽しかった！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私も楽しかったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私の絵が下手すぎて、壁の持ち主が気に入らなかったらどうしよう……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あははっ、まだ気にしてたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 心配しないでも大丈夫、グラフィティはその人の個性を表現する芸術だから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生が描いた絵にも、先生の個性が十分に表れてたよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いつかまた、こういう機会があったらいいな

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 미안한데…… 잠깐 시간 괜찮아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 무슨 일인데?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그게, 나 좀 데리러 와주지 않을래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 여기서 나가려면 신원보증인이 필요하다고 하는데, 학생회에 연락하기는 좀 그래서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 지금 어디에 있냐면…… 파출소야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 파출소?!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘은 도와줘서 고마워, 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하마터면 밀레니엄 학생회에 끌려가서 이중으로 잔소리를 들을 뻔했지 뭐야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그러니까 앞으로는 시내에서 말썽은 부리지 마.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응, 앞으로는 공공장소에 그래피티를 하지 않도록 조심할게……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 대신 약속한 대로 다음번에는 같이 커다란 캔버스에 함께 그림을 그리는 거야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 약속이야, 약속!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응, 약속할게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘도 고생 많았어, 선생님. 조심해서 들어가~!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 마키도 수고했어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님은 오늘 방과 후에 무슨 특별한 일정이라도 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나는 오늘 방과 후에 블랙마켓……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 남구 쪽에 볼일이 있어서 먼저 가볼게!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: ……블랙마켓?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 우으, 아쉬워라……. 사람들에게 BOOM의 매력을 전파할 좋은 기회였는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그런 행동은 민폐라니까…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 알겠어. 선생님이 안 된다면 어쩔 수 없지…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그나저나 선생님, BOOM 직접 해 본 적 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 없는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 다음번에 선생님 핸드폰에도 깔아줄 테니까, 같이 스피드런 도전하자!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 3분 이내로 클리어할 수 있도록 옆에서 같이 도와줄게!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그 도전에 무슨 특별한 의미라도 있는 거야……?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 이번 쪽지 시험 문제 봤어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 말도 안 되게 어려웠다고!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그러니까 평소부터 예습, 복습을 철저히 했어야지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 예고한 시험 범위 밖에서 문제가 나왔어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 윽, 정론이긴 하지만…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 그런 건 아니지만…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어쨌든! 이대로 가다가는 보충 수업을 받게 되어버려~

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 나 좀 도와줘~

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 공부 가르쳐줘서 고마워, 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님에 기대에 부응할 수 있도록 다음 시험에서는 꼭 만점을 받아올게!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 기대하고 있을게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: …그런데 선생님,

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 노트 뒷면에 있는 쿨링 오프 기간에 대한 설명은 어느 시험에 나오는 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 우선 마키 양은 시험 범위에 대한 이해부터 다시 하도록 합시다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님! 얼마 전에 치른 재시험에서 만점을 받았어!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 후후, 선생님이 저번에 가르쳐 준 특별 수업 덕분이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 축하해. 마키도 공부하느라 수고 많았어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나 잘했지? 더 칭찬해 줘, 더~!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 시험공부를 하느라 수고한 마키를 위해 시내에서 아이스크림을 사줄게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 정말? 약속한 거다, 선생님!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이 메시지, 캡처해두었으니까 나중에 무르기 없기야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 쓰레기 치우는 거 도와줘서 고마워, 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……그리고 몰래 낙서한 것도 모른 척해줘서 고마워.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 이번에는 좋은 일을 하려고 했던 거니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 우으…… 그래도 경찰 아저씨에게 걸려서 혼나면 어쩌지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그때는 선생님이 꼭 경찰에게 잘 말해줘야 해. 꼭이야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 좋은 소식이 있어!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이 메시지를 보면 바로 전의 그래피티를 그렸던 회벽 앞으로 와 줘.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 무슨 일인데?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그건 와 보면 바로 알 수 있어!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 참, 옷은 더러워져도 괜찮은 옷으로 입고 와야 해!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 후후, 오늘은 선생님이랑 같이 그래피티를 그릴 수 있어서 정말 즐거웠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 나도 정말 즐거웠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 내가 그림을 너무 못 그려서 벽 주인이 싫어하지 않을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하하, 뭐야. 아직도 그 말을 신경 쓰고 있었던 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 걱정하지 마. 그래피티는 각자의 개성을 표현하는 예술이니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님이 그린 벽화는 선생님의 개성을 충분히 잘 표현하고 있었어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다음에도 또 이런 기회가 있었으면 좋겠네~

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, I'm sorry...but do you have a minute?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sure.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's up?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um, can you come pick me up?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They said I need a guarantor to get out of here, but I don't want to contact the Student Council.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Right now, I'm...at a police station.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A police station?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for your help today, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I thought I was gonna get dragged into the Millennium Student Council.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Don't go causing any more trouble in the city.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay. From now on, I won't tag in public...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Next time, we'll paint on a canvas. Together!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Promise me! Do you promise?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Okay, promise.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You worked hard today, Sensei. Goodbye!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You did a lot today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, do you have any plans after school today?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I was gonna go to the Black Market after school...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No, I mean, I have something to do in the South District, so I gotta go!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: The Black Market?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh, that's too bad... This was a great opportunity to share the charm of BOOM with people.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That would have been a real inconvenience...for everyone else.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay, if you say so...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: By the way, Sensei. Have you ever played BOOM before?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: No, I haven't.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then I'll install it on your phone. Let's do a speedrun together!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I can help you clear it in less than three minutes!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Is there any particular reason for this challenge?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, did you see that quiz?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It was so hard!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That means you should've studied and prepared more thoroughly.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Were the questions not what you expected for the test?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh, you got me, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I mean, no, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, I'm gonna need to take make-up classes as this rate!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Please help me, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thanks for helping me study, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll definitely get a perfect score on my next test! I'll live up to your expectations!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm looking forward to it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...By the way, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The explanation for the cooling-off period on the back of the notes... Which test is that for?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Maki, let's start by examining the scope of the test again.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei! I got a perfect score on the make-up test!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee. I couldn't have done it without your special lesson.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Congratulations. You worked really hard.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Didn't I do great? Tell me I did a great job! Come on!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll take you into the city for some ice cream, since you worked so hard for the test.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Really? You promise, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I took a screenshot of this message, so you can't cancel on me!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for helping clean up the trash, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Also, thank you for pretending not to know about the graffiti.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You were trying to do something good this time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh... Still, what if that cop finds out and I get in trouble?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If that happens, please talk to the cop for me, okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, I have good news!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: When you see this message, come to the wall that I tagged before.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's up?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You'll know when you get there!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, and be sure to wear something that you don't mind getting dirty!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee, I had so much fun tagging with you today, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I had a lot of fun too.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Do you think the owner of the wall will hate my art? It's not too sloppy, is it?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Haha, what? Are you still worried about that?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't worry about that. Graffiti is an art that expresses individuality.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I thought your mural expressed your personality quite well.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I hope I get another opportunity like this soon!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอโทษนะคุณครู... แต่พอมีเวลามั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้อยู่นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีเรื่องอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คือว่า... ช่วยออกมารับฉันหน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พอดีว่าถ้าจะออกไปจากที่นี่ต้องมีคนมา
ยืนยันน่ะ แล้วฉันก็ไม่กล้าติดต่อสภานัก
เรียน...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เอ่อ.. ที่นี่คือ... ป้อมตำรวจน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ป้อมตำรวจเหรอ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณที่ช่วยนะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เกือบโดนลากไปที่สภานักเรียนมิลเลเนียม
แล้วโดนบ่นเข้าแล้วไง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ต่อไปก็อย่าไปหาเรื่องใส่ตัวในเมืองล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อืม.. ต่อไปฉันจะไม่ไปพ่นกราฟิตี้ในที่
สาธารณะอีก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ว่าต้องทำตามสัญญานะ เราจะไปวาด
รูปลงผ้าใบผืนใหญ่ด้วยกัน!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สัญญาต้องเป็นสัญญานะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้ ครูสัญญา

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ขอบคุณมากนะคุณครู กลับดีๆ ล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มากิก็ด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู หลังเลิกเรียนวันนี้มีธุระอะไรเป็น
พิเศษมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หลังเลิกเรียนวันนี้ฉันมีธุระที่ตลาดมืด...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่สิ มีธุระในเขตมินามิต่างหาก ไปก่อนนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ตลาดมืดงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เฮ้อ น่าเสียดายจัง นั่นคือโอกาสที่
คนอื่นจะได้เห็นเสน่ห์ของ BOOM แท้ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แต่การทำแบบนั้นมันรบกวนคนอื่นนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
รู้แล้วแหละน่า ถ้าครูไม่สะดวกฉันก็จะไม่
ตื๊อหรอก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ว่าแต่ คุณครูเคยเล่น BOOM มาก่อนมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ล่ะ ครูไม่เคย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นเอาไว้ฉันจะโหลดลงมือถือของคุณครู
ให้ แล้วเรามาเล่นโหมดสปีดด้วยกัน!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันจะช่วยให้คุณครูผ่านได้ใน 3 นาทีเลย
ล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เกมนั่นมันมีความหมายอะไรเป็นพิเศษ
เหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู เห็นข้อสอบรอบนี้หรือยัง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ยากเกินบรรยายเลยล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: บอกแล้วไงว่าต้องฝึกและทบทวนให้มากๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
มีข้อไหนที่ออกนอกเหนือขอบเขตด้วย
เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จริงๆ ก็แล้วแต่จะคิด...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่สิ ฉันไม่ได้หมายความแบบนั้น...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เอาเถอะ! ถ้าขืนยังเป็นแบบนี้ฉันต้องไป
เรียนเสริมแน่เลย~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูช่วยฉันหน่อยสิ~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณที่ช่วยสอนนะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แล้วฉันจะทำคะแนนเต็มในการสอบครั้ง
หน้าให้ได้ตามที่ครูคาดหวังเลยล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แล้วครูจะรอนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ว่าแต่... คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คำอธิบายของช่วงเวลาคลายความตึง
เครียดที่เขียนไว้หลังสมุดนั่น... มันจะ
ออกสอบวิชาไหนเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เอาเป็นว่ามากิอ่านตรงที่จะออกสอบ
ให้เข้าใจก่อนแล้วกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู! ฉันสอบซ่อมได้คะแนนเต็มด้วย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะคุณครูช่วยสอนฉันไว้เมื่อคราวที่
แล้วยังไงล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ดีใจด้วยนะ มากิเองก็พยายามได้ดีมาก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันทำได้ดีใช่มั้ยล่ะ? งั้นชมกันอีกนิดสิ
นะ นะ~!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นครูจะซื้อไอศกรีมจากในเมืองให้
เป็นของขวัญที่เธอตั้งใจอ่านหนังสือสอบ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จริงเหรอ? สัญญานะ!?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันแคปข้อความไว้หมดแล้วนะ ห้ามเท
กันล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณที่ช่วยเก็บขยะนะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แล้วก็ขอบคุณที่ทำเป็นไม่เห็นที่ฉันวาดรูป
ไว้ด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ก็ครั้งนี้เธอไม่ได้มีเจตนาไม่ดีอะไรนี่

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... แต่ถ้าตำรวจไปเห็นเข้าล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเป็นแบบนั้นจริงๆ คุณครูต้องช่วยพูด
ให้นะ ต้องมาช่วยฉันนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันมีข่าวดีมาบอกล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเห็นข้อความนี้ ช่วยมาที่กำแพงที่ฉัน
ไปทำกราฟิตี้ไว้คราวก่อนทีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีเรื่องอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้ามาก็รู้เองล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จริงสิ! ใส่เสื้อผ้าที่เลอะได้มาล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฮุฮุ วันนี้สนุกมากเลยที่ได้ทำกราฟิตี้กับ
คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูก็สนุกมากเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ครูวาดรูปไม่ได้เรื่องเลย เจ้าของ
กำแพงจะไม่พอใจหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อะไรกัน? ยังสนใจอะไรแบบนั้นอยู่อีก
เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ต้องห่วงนะ กราฟิตี้คือศิลปะที่ถ่าย
ทอดอารมณ์ศิลปินแต่ละคนออกมา

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แล้วกำแพงนั่นก็ถ่ายทอดอารมณ์ของคุณ
ครูได้ดีแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อยากให้เราได้สนุกกันแบบนี้อีกจัง~

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，抱歉……可以耽誤一點時間嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒問題唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼了？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那個……能來接我嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 說是需要身份保證人，但不太好聯絡學生會……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 地點是那個，這個……派出所

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 派出所！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天謝謝你來，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 聯絡學生會的話，又要被唸一頓

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 從今以後要注意唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯。盡量不在公共場所塗鴉……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 按照今天約定好的，下次要一起在大畫布上作畫喔！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 約好囉！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，約好了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天也辛苦了，老師。回去小心唷～！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 真紀也辛苦了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師今天放學後有什麼事嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我要去黑

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呀，南區那邊有事要辦，先回去囉～

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……黑市？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 太可惜了……明明是向更多人傳達毀滅狂戰士魅力的機會

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 給別人添麻煩的做法是不行的……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔，老師說不行的話就沒辦法了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 話說回來，老師有玩過毀滅狂戰士嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不，沒有

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下次我幫你下載，一起「Speedrun」吧！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 直到能在3分鐘內過關之前，我會在旁邊幫你的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 照你的說法，難不成想跨過3分鐘的門檻是相當困難的嗎……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師有從別人那裡聽說這次的小考嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 難到難以置信！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 平時不好好預習跟複習是不行的唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 難道是出了考試範圍外的題目嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔，正確的言論……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不，不是那樣的……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總之！這樣下去就得去補課了～！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，幫幫我～！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 謝謝你教我念書，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 為了回應老師的期待，下次考試會拿滿分的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，我很期待

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，還有一個問題

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 筆記本最後的鑑賞期說明，是所有科目的考試都會出嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 真紀，稍微冷靜一下吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！上次的考試，拿到滿分唷！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵，多虧了老師上次教我念書！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 恭喜，真紀也努力念書了呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 很了不起吧？再多稱讚一點～！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那就去市區給努力的真紀買支冰淇淋吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 真的嗎！？約好了唷，老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 已經截圖下來了，之後不能假裝不知道唷！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 謝謝你幫忙清理垃圾，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 還有，放我一馬。謝啦

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這次是出於善意才做的吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯！啊……但是，如果被警察發現並被責罵的話怎麼辦……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 到時候老師要說「不是這樣的」！絕對要喔！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，好消息！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 看到這條訊息的話，可以來之前塗鴉的牆壁嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼了？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 來了就知道了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，要穿弄髒了也沒關係的衣服唷！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵，能跟老師一起塗鴉很開心！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我也很開心

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我畫的太差了，如果牆壁的主人不喜歡的話怎麼辦……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊哈哈，還是很在意嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不用擔心，塗鴉是表現個性的藝術

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師畫的畫也充分展現了老師的個性

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 希望有一天還有這種機會
